review_notes.rounds: Round 1 REQUEST_CHANGES on two honesty findings: the uppercase branch required a leading character that ate the keyword's own first letter, so bare env-var names never matched despite the documented promise; and a stale spec paragraph claimed the AUR-435 files were outside paths after they had been added and rebased. Round 2 APPROVE, both re-verified through the reviewer's own vectors.
review_notes.false_positive_evidence: 15 benign cases written by the reviewer stayed clean before and after the fix, re-confirmed through the production SecurityScan path; new adversarials 9TOKEN= and MY-TOKEN= now match but are not valid identifiers in any real language or format
review_notes.scope_choice: only hardcoded-secret was given a matcher; the other five rules are declared metadata-only in the YAML and the spec rather than given weak patterns
